instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Beacon Digital is an integrated aquaculture operation focused on high-volume production of tilapia and seabass. The company operates large, high-density tanks requiring precise environmental control, making feed cost optimization and disease management critical for maintaining margins in competitive export markets.
answers.pastInitiatives: We recently launched a digital customer onboarding flow that reduced average onboarding time from 12 days to 5 days. Furthermore, we implemented an internal dashboard tracking real-time feed conversion ratios (FCR) across three pilot sites, which provided the first quantitative data points for our efficiency initiatives.
answers.strategicGoals: Cost reduction and process optimization are our dominant strategic priorities. Our industry is experiencing margin compression due to rising input costs and price-sensitive customers. We need to systematically identify and eliminate inefficiencies across procurement, production, logistics, and back-office functions.
answers.additionalContext: We have a new CEO who joined 3 months ago from a more digitally mature industry. She has signaled that innovation and digital transformation will be top strategic priorities, replacing the previous leadership's conservative, cost-cutting orientation. The organization is cautiously optimistic but also uncertain about what concrete changes to expect.
answers.teamSize: The technology organization is structured into product-aligned squads with a central platform team of 5 engineers enabling shared infrastructure. Innovation is driven by a '20% time' policy where all engineers can dedicate one day per sprint to self-directed projects, plus a quarterly internal pitch competition where winning ideas receive seed funding and 3 months of dedicated squad allocation.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Predictive Feed Optimization (Efficiency Focus)
opportunities.rationale: Implementing machine learning models to analyze historical feed performance data alongside real-time environmental variables will allow for predictive adjustments in feed formulation and feeding schedules. This directly addresses the primary cost driver while minimizing waste.

first_actions: Establish a dedicated Data Science task force.
Pilot ML model on one high-volume tilapia line.
Integrate with existing ERP/feeding software APIs.
resources_needed: Software license for predictive analytics platform
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 5% reduction in average FCR within the first fiscal quarter.
milestones: Q1: Model development and validation complete (Budget: $50k).
Q2: Full integration into production system pilot.

opportunities.title: IoT Sensor Network for Proactive Disease Monitoring (Efficiency Focus)
opportunities.rationale: Deploying a network of low-cost IoT sensors to monitor water quality, dissolved oxygen levels, and temperature in real-time. This shifts the operational paradigm from reactive treatment to proactive prevention, reducing losses due to outbreaks.

first_actions: Identify three high-risk tank zones for initial sensor deployment.
Select an end-to-end sensor hardware provider.
Define SOPs for automated alerts and maintenance.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce disease incidence rate by 15% within one year.
milestones: Q1: Sensor installation and baseline data collection complete.
Q3: Full operational deployment and alert system validation.

opportunities.title: Closed-Loop Automated Farming System (Radical)
opportunities.rationale: Invest in research and development for a fully automated, climate-controlled recirculating aquaculture system (RAS) module. This radical approach bypasses environmental variability and drastically reduces external energy and water costs, offering exponential long-term efficiency gains.

first_actions: Allocate $100k for an external R&D feasibility study on RAS viability.
Identify strategic partnership with a specialized agritech startup.
Form a cross-functional task force (Ops, Engineering, Finance).
resources_needed: Seed funding for prototype development ($250k reserved)
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve a projected 30% reduction in operational utility costs compared to current open-system tanks.
milestones: Q1: Feasibility study completion and concept validation (Budget: $100k).
Q4: Prototype testing and Go/No-Go decision.

next_steps.action: Form a cross-functional Innovation Steering Committee to prioritize and fund the high-potential opportunities identified.
Conduct detailed financial modeling for the Radical Closed-Loop System feasibility study and secure preliminary R&D budget approval from the formal committee.
Launch a dedicated 'Efficiency Task Force' focused solely on implementing the incremental IoT sensor network for disease monitoring (low-hanging fruit).

key_weaknesses: Siloed digital maturity across operational teams, leading to inconsistent data quality.
Heavy reliance on manual processes and spreadsheets in critical areas like procurement and logistics.
Potential cultural resistance to radical technological shifts due to the previous conservative leadership orientation.
